claim: The builtin researcher subagent is the component currently configured with web_search, fetch_content, and get_search_content tools and writes a research.md brief.
evidence: The researcher frontmatter lists tools read, write, web_search, fetch_content, get_search_content, intercom and output research.md.
relevance: Parallel research should use builtin researcher workers for source discovery while keeping canonical graph ingestion separate.
title: Builtin researcher can perform web research

claim: pi-subagents supports background runs that continue after control returns to the parent and can be inspected with status actions.
evidence: The documentation states that background runs keep working after control returns and can be inspected with subagent status.
relevance: The proposal can let the parent keep working while spawning and monitoring research jobs asynchronously.
title: Subagents support background execution

claim: pi-subagents supports outputMode=file-only for large child outputs so the parent can receive a compact file reference instead of full content.
evidence: The documentation says outputMode=file-only returns only a concise file reference for saved output.
relevance: Parallel researchers and archivists should write isolated artifacts and return compact receipts to avoid bloating parent context.
title: File-only outputs are supported

claim: The current manage_jsonl upsert path reads an entire JSONL file, updates or appends a matching record, then writes the whole file atomically with rename.
evidence: upsert reads readJsonl, mutates the records array, and writeJsonlAtomic writes a tmp file then renameSyncs it into place.
relevance: Concurrent canonical writes can still lose updates without a lock or queue even if final file replacement is atomic.
title: Current JSONL upsert is read-modify-write

claim: The cartographer_jsonl tool currently exposes validate-topic, validate-file, validate-misses, list-misses, list, upsert, and seed-pi-facts, but no queue or transactional commit action.
evidence: CartographerJsonlParams and Type.Literal tool schema list only the existing actions.
relevance: Supporting queued archivist ingestion requires new JSONL tool actions and CLI commands.
title: JSONL tool exposes no queue actions today

claim: Proposal fact citation validation currently recognizes only bracketed numeric fact IDs matching [F followed by digits].
relevance: If the queue introduces content-hash or nano-style fact IDs, validators and citation guidance must be updated together.
title: Fact citation parser is numeric today

claim: Cartographer already validates receipt records and validation receipts, requiring id/type/status and command or validation evidence.
evidence: validateReceiptRecords checks required fields, validation evidence, truncated-output metadata, and timeout fallback decisions.
relevance: Queue commits should produce validation/commit receipts that fit the existing receipt validation model rather than inventing an untracked side channel.
title: Validation receipts are already modeled

claim: validation_runner.py can execute a validation command and append a receipt containing command, exit code, duration, hash-set digest, changed files, and validation evidence.
evidence: The runner builds a validation-receipt with status, command, exit_code, duration_ms, hash_set_digest, changed_files, verified, and verification.validation.
relevance: Final queue and proposal validation should use trusted command-generated receipts where possible.
title: Validation runner records command evidence

claim: The cartographer-archivist agent is intended to produce source-backed source/fact/supported_by JSONL suggestions, but its current tool allowlist is only read,bash,write.
evidence: The agent frontmatter lists tools read,bash,write, and the rules say it produces source-backed JSONL suggestions.
relevance: The proposal should upgrade archivist into a controlled queue-bundle producer or ingester with cartographer_jsonl access instead of broad parent-only ingestion.
title: Archivist is narrow and lacks JSONL tools

claim: The proposal skill keeps the parent responsible for orchestration, artifact integrity, index freshness, and final validation while subagents contribute scoped judgment.
evidence: Delegation guidance states to keep the parent responsible for orchestration, artifact integrity, index freshness, and final validation.
relevance: The queue design should automate ingestion while preserving a parent final validation gate.
title: Proposal workflow keeps parent as orchestrator
